steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Kal'tsit? Are you listening?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: The last treatment worked very well. Count Hohenlohe has gotten much better. Thank you for your help.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Oh, wait a moment.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I don't recommend letting yourself get distracted in battle.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: This is hardly a battle. Don't worry. It'll be over soon.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Back on topic... I will be staying a little longer than usual at Rhodes Island this time. That won't be a problem, will it?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island will never turn away its operators.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: You can get to the point and say I'm welcome.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If that's what you want to hear, you're welcome here.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Right... makes me wonder if I should say you're straight to the point or beating around the bush.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Whatever. Let us talk about the next treatment, then.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Medical will formulate the medicine used in the next treatment based on the physical examination data you provided. This will take some time, but not too long.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I still insist that the Count receive regular, detailed examinations. That's the only way we can plan out his treatment effectively.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Best if I bring him to you for a checkup, right?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Considering the Count's position, that is far too risky. Too bad. Things could have been so much simpler if certain people were less stubborn.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: In any case, until the medicine's formulated, I will be working alongside Ankhesena... the little squirt. I trust you'll have no problem with that?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You are free to do as you please.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Wonderful, then.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Ah, right. One more thing...

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Looks like some pests managed to follow our tracks. The Count is a popular man, and even a lowly attendant like me gets followed.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: But don't worry. This won't affect Rhodes Island whatsoever. I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Okay, let me think. What should I do with you?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Instead of Rhodes Island's gentle way of doing things, I'm much better at silencing people directly... It makes things much easier for everyone.

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: W-What are you doing?!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Why are you shaking? If you chose to be a robber, surely you must've been prepared for this to happen one day?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Relax, the pain will stop in no time—

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Sis, I'm done with my part.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Sis?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Ankhesena, what are you doing here? Have you taken off all the guys on your side?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: The Medic Operators are treating the injured, and I helped by bringing them medicine.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Good job.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: It was nothing.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Oh, nothing special...

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Just having a friendly chat with the nice men here.

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: (The bitch's lying!)

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: (Friendly chat my ass!)

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: *cough*.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Friendly... chat?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Friendly chat!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Mm, okay...

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Hello?

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: You talking to us?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Yep. After that lesson, you know how awesome we are, don't you?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: So please stop trying to bother the Pioneer Team. They are very hardworking people, and please find an honest job.

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: Huh? Work? What are you talking about, you punk ass...

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: (Hm? You want to repeat that?)

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: Urk...

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: (Shut up, idiot!)

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: (Ow! What are you smacking me for...?)

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: D-Don't worry! We definitely won't ever look for no trouble with the Pioneer Team ever again. We... We will work the hardest we can!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: ...Really?

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Of course. Of course! We've learned our lesson, much thanks to you two!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Your word's not worth much.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Okay, that's good to hear.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Ankhesena?!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Are you sure about this?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Hmm... Is that not good enough?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Let me think...

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: No, we'll handle this your way. I'll always support your decisions.

The short-haired Caprinae pauses for a moment and turns her gaze from her younger sister to the bandits beside her. Though her eyes sweep past them only very briefly, it's evident they are blood-colored, cold, and harsh.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Sis? What's wrong?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Hm? Oh.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: It's nothing. If this is taken care of, then let's go back.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: ...Okay.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Wow, they actually left.

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: What do we do, Boss? Are we really gonna do honest work?

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: W-What kind of work can we do?

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Work? Work your ass!

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Now hurry and get everyone up! We're leaving!

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: Alright, alright! Sheesh, why smack me again...?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Okay, this should do it for now.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Your injuries aren't very serious, but you should try to avoid any intense physical labor for a while and let your body rest as much as you can.

steps.name: Injured Pioneer
steps.text: But if we don't hurry up and finish the construction, those bandits will...

steps.name: Strong Pioneer
steps.text: Alright! Don't worry about it. We'll figure it out somehow.

steps.name: Strong Pioneer
steps.text: Don't worry, Doc. We'll keep an eye on our wounded and make sure they rest up!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Are you finished treating the injured?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: I taught those bandits a lesson with Ankhesena... Beeswax. Is there anything else we can help you with?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Carnelian! Thank you so much for escorting me here!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I'm finished with the Pioneers' treatment. Their injuries aren't serious, and even the Infected among them aren't in particularly dire condition.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: The mission itself can be called a success, but...

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: You're worried about the bandits?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: They have been operating here for a while now. It doesn't look like they'll stop just because you teach them a lesson or two.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: And we're only here on a mission. Can't always help out... can we?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: *sigh*... Everyone can tell at a glance there is nothing we can do about those men, but that little squirt still has no idea.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: How worrying.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Haha... Beeswax is working very hard already, though! The first time we went on a mission together, she got so lost that she didn't make her way back to the campsite until the morning on the third day...

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Oh? She didn't tell me that one. Maybe I could take you out to dinner one day and hear the whole story?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I would love to, if we get the chance! I want to show you the specialties we have on offer at the Rhodes Island canteen, too!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Speaking of which, where is Beeswax?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: She said she's got something to do by herself.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Huh? By herself?! S-She's not going to get lost again, is she...?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I'm a little surprised, though. I thought you would be so worried that you would follow her.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: If I try to have a hand in everything, she'll never grow up.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Ankhesena is out here to gain experience; it's not so bad to let her experience more by herself. Guardians who keep kids on a tight leash will only find themselves hated—That said, I'm worried, of course.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: That's why... if you don't mind, is it okay if I take charge of this bandit problem?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Do you have a good way to solve this? If there's anything I can do, I can...

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Thanks, but there's no need.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Most Rhodes Islanders might find my methods a little... strange.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: W-What do you mean by that...?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Hah hah, don't worry about it. Just leave it to me.
At first, joining Rhodes Island was only a stopgap measure.
The young Count is afflicted with a disgraceful disease and must mix with Leithanien's upper crust while hiding his identity as an Infected.
He is still a boy, but his demeanor is already like that of a seasoned veteran.
But in Carnelian's eyes, instead of a dignified image, he instead reminds her of a young, seriously injured beast who had lost its parents that she once saw.
Confronted by hunters, it bared its fangs and raised its hackles, feigning the last bit of dignity it could manage as a wild beast.
In the beginning, that was the only reason why she chose to stick her nose into that.
And the agreement she signed with Rhodes Island was but one of the many insignificant things she had no choice but to do at the time.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Hey, what are you strolling out here at this hour for?

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: My head hurts so bad I can't sleep. Ugh, what a ruthless bitch...

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: We made this trip all for nothing, thanks to that wretched woman.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: As soon as those Rhodes Island busybodies leave, we're going to teach that Pioneer Team a real lesson! See if they still dare to—
Dare to what?

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Who goes there?!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Good evening, gentlemen.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: It sounds like you're having an interesting conversation. Mind if I join?

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: You... You're the crazy bitch from this afternoon!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: My, how rude.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: But fine. This is actually just perfect. If you got polite all of a sudden, I might not be able to bring myself to do this.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: W-What are you going to do?!

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Y-You promised us you'd let us go this afternoon...

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Hmm? Did I?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: I did say I'd support Ankhesena's decision, but let you go?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Peculiar. Did I ever say that?

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: You stinkin' bitch!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Oh, don't get yourselves so worked up, gentlemen.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Your profanities won't save you, but before I deal with you, I have a little question.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: We'll give you an answer, but we need your word that you won't kill us.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Urgh!!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Sorry, but I'm not here to discuss terms.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: It seems you don't quite understand the situation you are in. I shouldn't have been so lenient on you in the daylight.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: My hand! No, please! I'll tell you anything. Please let me go!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Very well—
Wait!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: (...Again?!)

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Carnelian! We finally caught up to you...

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Sis, wait. Don't hurt them.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: *cough*, Ankhesena, listen to me. This is just a misunderstanding. I'm having a happy little chat with these gentlemen...

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Sis.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: I'm not stupid.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: I know the way you fight. You don't have to hide it from me.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: The elders all told me when you went hunting for the first time, you came back completely drenched in blood, and your prey was in tatters.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: You're way too direct and rough with how you handle things!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: The elders tell you everything, huh?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Okay, I'll stop... but what do you plan on doing with them?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: You shouldn't expect them to go get jobs after you free them, and if you leave them be, who knows what they'll do in the future... We won't be staying here forever.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Yes, I know that.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: But, Sis, this is Columbia.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: You mean...?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Maybe we should follow Columbia's rules.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hehe, Beeswax's really thought of everything. She went into the city by herself this afternoon just to take care of this.

steps.name: Columbian Police
steps.text: Police. Sorry we got here late.

steps.name: Columbian Police
steps.text: Are these the bandits that attacked the Pioneer Team on multiple occasions and have been assaulting passersby in the area that you mentioned?

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Shit... It had to be these cops...

steps.name: Columbian Police
steps.text: Hmph, you degenerates, huh?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: There's more, too! Officer, please come with me!

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: I asked the Pioneer Team. These men have done plenty of bad things here before this. If they're caught, they probably won't get to come back for a while.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Now they can't do anything bad anymore.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Well... I'm surprised you thought of this.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Back home, we wouldn't even begin to think about talking to the police, but the Doctor says I have to learn to follow the local customs wherever I go.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: And we have to borrow all the strength we can... The Doctor taught me that, too.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: I see, so the Doctor taught you...

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Hahah.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Ankhesena.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Do you like Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Yep...

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: I sure do.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Is it okay if I ask why?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: There are lots of kind people at Rhodes Island. If I stay there, I can see a lot more things that I haven't seen and learn lots of new stuff.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Isn't that what we came out into the world to do?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: It's true. Those traditions exist so we have a chance to understand the outside world, to absorb knowledge that we're interested in, and to see things that we've never seen.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: That's how I made it all the way here, and now it's your turn, Ankhesena.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Yes... I understand that well.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Sis? What's wrong? Are you... Are you sad?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: No. I'm actually very happy.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Who would've thought that the little squirt who clung to my leg all those years ago would say something that makes so much sense? Oh, how time flies.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: I'm a little sad I couldn't see how you grow so dependable, though.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Yep, I guess I'll have a chat with the Doctor sometime. I'm sure I'll learn lots of interesting things about you.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Sis!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Haha, I'll stop teasing you.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: You did very well. I'm glad you know how to solve the challenges you face, your own way.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: What I said still stands. It doesn't matter what you want to do. I'll always support your decisions. So don't be afraid, no matter what comes your way. Just do as you will.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Right, I understand.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: You're going to leave soon, right?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Sorry... I can't always be there with you.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: It's okay.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: It's fine. While you're gone, I'll keep traveling with Rhodes Island. I still have lots to learn...

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: I want to become even more dependable, so I can help you next time.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Phew, now I can rest easy, knowing you'll be fine at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Even if something unexpected happens on that end, you won't be in danger here.

spans.text: Even if something unexpected happens on
end, you won't be in danger here.

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: Sis...?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: You never let me in on the dangerous stuff you're doing! You big dummy!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Oh? Finally going to sulk?

steps.name: Beeswax
steps.text: (Pouts)

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Okay, don't be mad. Just like you're starting to discover your own way of doing things, I'm sure you know...

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: I have my ways, too.
Rhodes Island accepts people of all kinds. Some came together because of how like-minded they are, but even more of them, like her, opted to stay a while for all kinds of reasons.

From the bottom of her heart, Carnelian feels truly gratified, knowing that Ankhesena has been able to broaden her horizons, learn to think for herself, as well as understand and accept Rhodes Island's ideals.
Even though she herself only follows her heart, Carnelian thinks that, perhaps while she's around all these adorable Rhodes Islanders, she should restrain herself a little and work with them.
If she hangs around them long enough, perhaps she too will be influenced by them and become softer?
That's something to look forward to, but before that...

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: (No mistake. That Caprinae woman is Count Hohenlohe's attendant.)

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: (Someone so close to a Leithanian count is secretly in close contact with an Oripathy-related pharmaceutical company...)

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: (Rhodes Island, huh... Feels like I've heard that name before.)

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: (Anyway, I gotta get word about this to—)
Good evening again, vermin.

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: Y-You're the attendant—

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Shh.

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: Guh...!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: That's a great disguise. You almost fooled me.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Those nobles really don't mind all the trouble, do they? They're even sending men to keep an eye on a lowly servant like me.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: It took me quite a bit of work to sneak over here behind Ankhesena's back. She's not so easy to fool anymore.

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: *cough*... You... I knew it... You're...

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: Infect—

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Silence is golden, sir.

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: *cough*, ahh—!! My leg!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Did that hurt?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Come, tell me who's behind all this, and I'll send you on your merry way. How about it?

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: It's ironic how many vicious methods those civilized men came up with. I'm not very used to them, but if you're so stubborn, I have no choice but to give them a try.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: I guess you wouldn't want to try them out, though?

steps.name: Vulgar Bandit
steps.text: Ugh... Ah... Ahh...!

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: This should do for now.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: I need to report the situation to the Count as soon as possible. Kids these days really are tough to deal with.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Right... If I don't head back soon, Ankhesena will probably get suspicious. She was a sharp girl to begin with, but she wasn't this clever. I wonder who she picked that up from.

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: *sigh*... Kids really do grow up so fast...

steps.name: Carnelian
steps.text: Well, seems I'll be going back in shame if I don't work a little harder.
